description:
Advances: ancora.derive
Ready-for: investigate

Symptom: derived/unresolved_calls is dominated by Kernel.SpecialForms and other syntax the reader cannot "resolve". On Argos aa8f738f7 (base aa8f738f7~10), the top sites for console.admin after the ancora-cmj summary are `unqualified <<>>/3`, `unqualified <-/2`, `unqualified for/2` and `unqualified <<>>/2`, each reached by 447 to 595 tests. In ancora itself, `unqualified <<>>/5 at test/ancora/derive/resolver_test.exs:441` tops ancora.derive.

Evidence:
- Ancora.Derive @ambient_modules includes Kernel.SpecialForms, which exports `<<>>/1` and `for/1` (one list argument). The resolver uses the AST argument count as the arity, so `<<a, b, c>>` looks up `<<>>/3` and misses.
- `<-` is not a function at all; it is clause syntax inside `for` and `with`, so it should never be recorded.
- Ecto.Query macros such as `from/2` and `type/2` show up as unqualified when imported in test support files.
- console.admin reports 8,397 unresolved call sites. The share caused by these forms is not measured yet.

Why now: since ancora-cmj the message lists the 10 most-reached sites. When those are special forms the finding stops being actionable, and every such entry also marks a carrier as incomplete for Compare (missing observations do not prove removal), which may hide real shrink.

Question for investigate: treat variadic special forms by name regardless of arity and skip `<-`, or normalize their arity before the ambient lookup? Measure the unresolved count on Argos and ancora before and after.

comments.text:
Decision and measurements (PR https://github.com/iautom8things/ancora/pull/12, release 1.3.4).

Decision: drop by Elixir's own table, not arity normalization. dispose_unqualified/4 now drops a call when Macro.special_form?(name, arity) is true or the name is `<-`, `when` or `.` (the anonymous call fun.(x), recorded before as `./1`). The check runs before local definitions and imports, because Elixir never lets them shadow a special form. Macro.special_form?/2 accepts `<<>>`, `for`, `fn`, `with`, `{}` and `super` at any arity and reads no loaded module, so the resolver stays pure. A `<<>>` walk clause skips bitstring modifier names (`size(2)` was unresolved `size/1`) and still walks size and unit expressions. `\\` never reaches the ladder (heads walk only defaults), so it is not listed. `->` already had its own walk clause.

Measurements, before -> after (distinct unresolved sites; tagged tests with any unresolved entry; derived findings; verdict):
- ancora, --base origin/main: 1,185 -> 836; 516/697 -> 423/700 (3 new tests); 7 info unresolved_calls -> 7; pass -> pass.
- Argos aa8f738f7, base aa8f738f7~10: 26,817 -> 16,044; 6,792 -> 6,064 of 11,047; 37 info unresolved_calls -> 36 (deploy.boot_migration is now complete); pass -> pass.
- Argos aa8f738f7, no base (resolves to aa8f738f7, empty diff): same numbers; 37 -> 36 info; pass -> pass.
- Extra, Argos base aa8f738f7~100: drift/growth findings identical, no shrink on either side, fail -> fail on the same two unrelated change/uncovered_file warnings.
- console.admin: 8,397 -> 5,648 sites, 788 -> 758 of 992 tests incomplete.
- Derived binding sets are identical before and after on all 37 Argos and 8 ancora subjects. Only unresolved entries changed, so no growth or drift can move. Shrink can now surface for the 728 Argos tests that became complete, and only for real removals.

Follow-up, not fixed here (different root cause): imported dependency calls are the largest remaining group on Argos: has_element?/2 (2,804 sites), has_element?/3 (2,549), live/2 (1,441), json_response/2 (767), Ecto.Query field/2 (676), type/2 (643), from/2 (569), element/2, post/3, render_click/1 and more. The gate never passes external_modules: to Derive.context/4, so external_exports is always empty in production, and imports injected by `use ConnCase`/`use DataCase` are invisible to the resolver (they surface as dynamic_module __using__/1). Fixing it needs the gate to collect non-member import targets, including those inside support modules' using blocks, and load their exports in the tool VM.

title: Resolver records variadic special forms as unresolved unqualified calls
